title: ui: a record form's inline field members (customFields, inline section entries) are not stamped recordBeingEdited, and the loose FormFieldSchema lets one author the stamp
body:
domain:ui#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmSzhXR4yUAgwq1bQRi

Filing gate: ③ an out-of-scope finding of contract review 6911356996 on PR #34253 (#34197), S1, which the reviewer accepted as a follow-up; carrier: seat.
Reader: `domain:ui` (`ui/packages/plugin-form/src/ObjectForm.tsx`, `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sectionFields.ts`, `ui/packages/types/src/zod/form.zod.ts`). Grade suggestion: p3 (the published spec is not affected: its `customFields` member is closed and declares no `lookupFilters`).
Dedupe: `is:issue is:open recordBeingEdited`: none.
Blocked-by: #34197 (PR #34253 introduces the `recordBeingEdited` stamp and `withRecordBeingEdited`)

## 维护者速读

#34197 让查找字段的 `{ $record }` 过滤只在「记录表单」里解析：表单用一个运行时戳 `recordBeingEdited` 声明「正在编辑一条记录」。但表单里直接内联写的字段（`customFields` 成员、内联分区条目、独立表单字段）不经过打戳的两个构建函数，所以它们的 `{ $record }` 条目被丢掉，而它们继承的说明却说会解析；同时 ui 侧的 `FormFieldSchema` 是宽松对象，这样的字段还能自己写上这个戳把自己打开，违背「没有文档能写这个键」的约定。

## Facts (read on PR #34253 head `503e0152`, record 6911356996)

- `withRecordBeingEdited` has two callers: `ObjectForm` (auto layout and the master-detail header) and `fromObjectSchema` in `sectionFields.ts` (modal, drawer, tabbed, wizard and sectioned forms).
- `ui/packages/types/src/zod/form.zod.ts` declares `FormFieldSchema` as a loose object and takes `lookupFilters` by reference to the spec row, describe included.
- An inline form field reaches the widget as written: not stamped, so its `{ $record }` entries are left out; and a written `recordBeingEdited` key is carried through.

## Ask

1. Stamp inline field members of a record form in the same two builders (they are fields of the record being edited), so their `{ $record }` entries resolve as the describe says.
2. Drop an authored `recordBeingEdited` key from any document-supplied form field before the stamp is applied, so only the builders can write it.
3. Pins: an inline `customFields` member with `{ $record }` resolves in a record form; a form field that writes `recordBeingEdited` itself outside a record form does not resolve; CONTROL today's stamped object fields unchanged. Ablate red.
4. Update the census/ledger note on `recordBeingEdited` to name what holds the runtime-only invariant.

⛔ Not a claim.
